headline: Bug Fixes — Minimap, Boundaries & Blob AI
body: Fixed the minimap drawing outside its frame when the player or enemies were near the right/bottom world border. Fixed the player being blocked before the right edge. Enemies now also properly bounce off all world borders. Improved enemy blob animation with a wobbly organic effect and smarter chase/flee AI.

headline: News System Launched
body: You can now read patch notes and updates directly in the game menu. Edit news.json to add new entries — just add a new object with date, tags (NEW/FIX/UPDATE), headline, and body fields.
